== Description ==
Players Committee gallery image of [[Luke? Luuuuke! (V) (Virtual Set 11: Gathering Storm) (PC Gallery Text)|Luke? Luuuuke! (V)]], present in the Internet Archive capture of 22 November 2007 at 14:01:58 UTC. It shows the earlier remastered gallery wording recorded on that page. The face prints collector number 26; both Players Committee sheets print 27. The capture establishes that the image was available by that time, not its first publication day.
